title: 云南复古水彩文旅海报
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE premium vertical 4:5 vintage watercolor travel-collage poster. The supplied China image is a STYLE AND COMPOSITION reference: emulate its warm aged ivory paper, subtle paper fibers, rich but softly muted watercolor illustration, delicate realistic ink detail, monumental antique-brown serif title, fine corner ornaments, poetic atmospheric transitions and layered foreground objects. The poster must feel like one continuous dreamlike landscape, with varied-scale landmarks connected by mist, water, foliage and softly bleeding watercolor edges. Elegant visual hierarchy, luminous atmospheric distance, refined detail throughout. Natural cream, mineral green, dusty blue-gray, ochre and pale peach palette. Keep top title clean and readable, preserve generous margins. Flat illustrated paper artwork, not a miniature diorama. No inset boxes, no architectural technical diagrams, no 3D display plinth, no watermark. Artistic geographic compression is intended, not a literal map. Text must be limited to the exact specified headings and short labels. SUBJECT: Yunnan province, China. Exact top heading in tasteful Chinese calligraphic characters "云南", enormous elegant antique-brown serif title "YUNNAN", then spaced small serif subtitle "SOUTH OF THE CLOUDS". Main landscape: upper left majestic snow-capped Jade Dragon Snow Mountain with alpine pines; upper right the recognizable Three Pagodas of Dali beside pale Erhai Lake, with the tall central square pagoda and two smaller matching side pagodas, backed by distant mountains. Midground a sweeping luminous mosaic of Yuanyang rice terraces curves across green hills, terraces holding soft blue, peach and silver reflections; a subtle mist transition leads to a small southern Xishuangbanna scene with an appropriately elegant Dai Buddhist temple roof and tropical foliage, not an oversized fantasy palace. Center a quiet lake and distant mountains create an atmospheric route through the composition. Lower left detailed Lijiang old-town gray tiled Naxi buildings, narrow clear canal, little stone bridge and modest red lanterns, drawn with care. On a middle-ground forest edge, a small Asian elephant with naturally smaller ears is an optional delicate regional wildlife accent; no giant animals crowding the architecture. Foreground a compact still life of Pu'er tea cake with a little loose tea, an unbranded earthenware teapot and two small cups, plus a plate of delicate rose flower pastries and a few roses; steam softly connects to the landscape. Local objects richly detailed but do not dominate. Fine handwritten labels only: "Yulong Snow Mountain", "Dali & Erhai", "Yuanyang", "Lijiang". Bottom footer exact text: "Where mountains meet clouds, and every path tells a story." Delicate understated Chinese-style geometric corner ornaments. Do not include the Great Wall, Temple of Heaven, Terracotta Army, panda, Guilin karst pillars or unrelated national landmarks. Preserve geographic and cultural specificity of Yunnan while composing a poetic collage.
